title: narrated-timeline/v1
description: Plan for a narrated walkthrough. Frozen to the smallest shape the player consumes: scenes, captions, derived offsets, optional disposition. `start` and `total_duration` are permitted but never required — they are derived from measured clip durations, and the invariant that start[n] == sum(duration[0..n-1]) is asserted by the test suite, not by this schema. Requiring them here would invite someone to author them, which silently kills the derived clock.

tts.description: Speech endpoint configuration. Optional: --no-audio builds without it. When present, endpoint, model and voice are required, because a silent fallback would aim requests at whatever happens to be listening on a port that belongs to someone else. Optional anchor_scene (or ref_audio/ref_text), language and temperature lock consistent speaker identity across scenes.

endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/speech URL. No default is shipped.

model.description: Model id served by that endpoint. No default is shipped.

voice.description: Server-defined voice name. No default is shipped.

anchor_scene.description: Optional scene id whose synthesized WAV and narration are sent as base64 ref_audio and ref_text to every other scene so speaker timbre stays consistent across the deck. Mutually exclusive with ref_audio.

ref_audio.description: Optional path (relative to the plan directory) to a reference WAV file sent as base64 ref_audio to every scene. Mutually exclusive with anchor_scene.

ref_text.description: Optional transcript matching ref_audio. Only valid when ref_audio is set.

language.description: Optional language code (for example 'en') forwarded to /v1/audio/speech.

temperature.description: Optional sampling temperature forwarded to /v1/audio/speech (for example 0.0 for stable acoustic delivery).

sentence_chunking.description: When true, synthesize multi-sentence scenes one sentence at a time against the voice anchor and stitch with clean inter-sentence breath pauses to prevent neural TTS duration compression on long paragraphs.

pace.description: Optional post-synthesis speaking-pace balancing. Normalizes voiced articulation rate (syllables/sec excluding internal pauses), loudness, and generous soft-consonant margins via pitch-preserving time-stretch before re-measuring final WAV durations and compiling a seamless master.wav track.

master_audio.description: DERIVED. Relative path to the single seamless concatenated master WAV compiled by the builder so playback never switches audio sources or chops syllables at scene edges.

total_duration.description: DERIVED. Written by the builder as the sum of scene durations. Never author this; a test asserts it equals the sum when present.

mermaid_source.description: Path or URL for the Mermaid script. Must resolve offline by default: a relative path to a vendored copy is the expected value, and the builder refuses to run without one unless --cdn is passed explicitly. No network default is shipped.

disposition.description: Set when the walkthrough ends on choices or unknowns. When present, the final scene must invite a reply, and the validator enforces that.

kind.description: Free-form label. Not validated today; do not attach meaning until something enforces it.

hud.description: Optional Architect HUD surface providing oversight-depth controls, high-level stats and trends, hierarchical agent-node chat handoffs (lead, specialist, or video walkthrough agent), and linked in-repo artifacts.

a2ui.description: Optional A2UI v1.0 declarative UI message stream (createSurface, updateComponents, updateDataModel) rendered in the action surface and inspectable as raw JSON.

id.description: Unique within the plan; the validator rejects duplicates.

mermaid.description: Mermaid source for this scene's one dominant diagram.

narration.description: Spoken text for the whole scene. Rejected if it ends in a broadcast sign-off.

captions.description: The same sentences as the narration, chunked for reading. Distributed evenly across the measured clip.

audio.description: Repo-relative path where the clip would live. A REFERENCE, not a committed artifact: build output is gitignored and the file's existence is deliberately not a schema condition.

duration.description: Measured clip length in seconds, written by the builder.

start.description: DERIVED. Written by the builder as the running sum of previous durations. Never author this; a test asserts the cumulative invariant when present.
